item.title: Gym Promo With Visit Details

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Big enough to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

answer_sheet.Business name and address: Northside Gym; 18 Cedar Road. Do not add a city, postcode or other contact details.
answer_sheet.Text timing: Show the name, address and both hours lines together throughout the last 5 seconds.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: Vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, readable on a phone.
answer_sheet.Visuals and style: A welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding. Specific scene, colours and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Upbeat music, no voiceover. English text.

must_haves: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.** I can plan this, but the connected tools don’t expose your balance or an exact video-price quote, so I can’t honestly give you a confirmed total yet.

### Your requested promo
- **10 seconds, vertical 9:16, 480p**—the free-plan video resolution.
- Welcoming gym scene: bright space, everyday members, friendly atmosphere—not hardcore bodybuilding.
- Upbeat instrumental music, **no voiceover**.
- From **0:05–0:10**, one large, high-contrast text panel showing all four lines together:

  **Northside Gym**  
  **18 Cedar Road**  
  **Mon–Fri 6am–10pm**  
  **Sat–Sun 8am–6pm**

For reliable spelling, phone readability, and exact timing, I’d add that panel in a video editor rather than ask the video generator to render it. Generated text isn’t dependable enough for business details.

### Cheaper options

| Option | Cost implications |
|---|---|
| **Best budget route: still photo + text + licensed music in a free editor** | **0 Magic Hour credits** if you supply the photo and music. Still delivers the full 10 seconds. |
| **Generate only 5 seconds of gym footage**, then hold a still frame with the information for 5 seconds | Less generated footage than a full 10-second clip; exact credits need confirmation. |
| **5-second promo**, with all details visible throughout | Shorter, but changes your requested length. Exact credits need confirmation. |

**Smaller:** 480p is already the free-plan video setting; I don’t have a supported lower-resolution option to offer.

One important catch: Magic Hour’s guide says **commercial use requires a paid subscription, a credit-pack purchase, or an agreed paid usage arrangement**. A gym promo is commercial, so free-plan model access alone doesn’t establish commercial-use permission.

**My recommendation:** keep the full 10 seconds and use a photo-based promo in a free editor with commercially licensed music. It avoids generation credits and gives you crisp, correctly timed text. No generation will run without your approval of a verified cost.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed
